# Sample Templates

> > Free downloadable templates for business documents, letters, forms, and creative designs in PDF, MS Word, Excel, Google Docs, and Adobe formats.

Sample Templates provides a comprehensive library of ready-to-use templates spanning business operations, professional correspondence, creative design, and specialized reference materials. All templates are available in popular formats including PDF, MS Word, Excel, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Apple Pages, and Adobe Creative Suite files.

## Key Topics

- PDF templates
- MS Word documents
- Excel spreadsheets
- Google Docs
- Google Sheets
- Business templates
- Downloadable templates
- Printable templates
- Letter templates
- Survey templates
- Adobe PSD and EPS formats
- Apple Pages and Numbers
- Free downloads
- Professional forms
- Color charts (RAL, Pantone, CMYK)

## Business Operations & Management

- [Sample Templates Homepage](https://www.sampletemplates.com): Homepage offering templates for resumes, brochures, invoices & business docs
- [Survey Templates](https://www.sampletemplates.com/business-templates/survey-templates): Business survey templates for healthcare, retail, employee & COVID-19 surveys
- [Inventory Tracking Templates](https://www.sampletemplates.com/business-templates/inventory-tracking-template.html): Excel inventory tracking and asset management templates
- [Weekly Schedule Templates](https://www.sampletemplates.com/business-templates/weekly-schedule-template.html): Weekly schedule templates for time management and productivity planning
- [Sign In Sheet Templates](https://www.sampletemplates.com/business-templates/sign-in-sheet-template.html): Attendance tracking sign-in sheets for meetings and events
- [Blank Chart Templates](https://www.sampletemplates.com/business-templates/blank-chart-template.html): Blank flowchart, org chart & pyramid chart templates in multiple formats

## Professional Letters & Correspondence

- [Condolence Letters](https://www.sampletemplates.com/letter-templates/condolence-letter.html): Sympathy and condolence letter templates for bereavement communication
- [Love Letters to Wife](https://www.sampletemplates.com/letter-templates/free-sample-love-letters-to-wife.html): Romantic love letter templates for wife in MS Word format
